shelf_note: Bulgakov's 1913 essay on Tolstoy, pre-reform orthography; matches the catalogue.
structure_note: The image is an unsplit two-page spread (printed pp. 24 and 25 on one leaf image); with_printed_number 14 of 26 records fits a book scanned as spreads. The OCR reads both pages; the translation covers only the left one.

tr_errors.source: а я клопъ ... клопа и подлеца
tr_errors.english: I was a louse ... a louse and a scoundrel
